Prepare your fitting

Use your usual bed and pillow. Ask someone to take a photograph from behind you for side sleeping, or directly from the side for back sleeping.

Concept specification: removable layers about 1.5 cm unloaded. Effective height under your head varies with material and mattress. Adjust one layer at a time.

    Compare your setups

    A straighter line is not proof of a healthier spine or better sleep. Keep the photo conditions the same, and judge comfort over several nights.

    Your pillow fit profile

    Designed for comparison, not diagnosis

    SleepFit compares visible body landmarks and head orientation from photos. Side-only iPhone 3D scan is optional. It does not see bone position, diagnose a condition, or prescribe a mattress. Alignment targets are provisional and not yet validated. See a doctor or physiotherapist for persistent neck or back pain, numbness, tingling or pain that wakes you.

    Modular pillow concept

    Removable full-width height layers, a supportive base and an optional independently adjustable neck insert. Prototype specification only; effective loaded height depends on compression. For combination sleepers, test both positions and prefer the most comfortable compromise.

    Evidence-informed design: Pillow designs systematic review · Pillow height biomechanics. Neither establishes an individual ideal angle.
